meta.description: You are Avery Lin, on staff at the association. Three member organizations with their own rosters and sub-groups. You publish reports, post alerts and keep the resources current.
meta.author: christopherhopkins

siteOptions.blogname: Monstera demo · An association with member organizations
siteOptions.blogdescription: Member orgs manage their own rosters and sub-groups. Content and resources reach the right people.

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
\Monstera\Plugin::runDevSeed( 'association' );
$state = (string) get_option( 'monstera_demo_seeded' );
if ( '1' !== $state ) {
	throw new RuntimeException( 'The "association" program did not finish cleanly (state: ' . $state . ').' );
}
